standard.title: Technical Guidelines for Examination and Certification of Cranes, Hoists, Lifts and Other Lifting Equipment

notes: module_kind = compliance per section 7.12: requirement 1 states a binding, objectively checkable obligation with a stated interval ('shall be tested and certified by a third party accredited by EIAC once every 12 months'). Presence and currency of an EIAC third-party certificate is a fact, not a judgement, so a report may legitimately claim COMPLIANT / NON-COMPLIANT. Issue date 29/01/2025 and version V 5.0 are taken from the document cover page and page footers, not the filename or portal record date (portal_document_date 2025-02-17 is a CMS date). Document also records superseded issue date 09/05/2024 (V 4.0). The document states NO certificate validity period anywhere; certificate_validity_months is therefore left null rather than inferred from the 12-month test interval (rule 3).

subjects.description: Industrial machines equipped with hoists, chains, or cables, used for lifting, lowering, and moving heavy materials or objects within a construction site, manufacturing facility, or other industrial settings. Includes overhead cranes, tower cranes and mobile cranes.
subjects.source_quote: Industrial machines equipped with hoists, chains, or cables, used for lifting, lowering, and moving heavy materials or objects within a construction site, manufacturing facility, or other industrial settings. Cranes come in several types, including overhead cranes, tower cranes, and mobile cranes, each serving specific purposes based on the intended application

subjects.description: Mechanized lifting devices designed to raise or lower heavy objects vertically, consisting of a drum or pulley system around which a chain or wire rope is wound.
subjects.source_quote: Mechanized lifting devices designed to raise or lower heavy objects vertically. Hoists typically consist of a drum or pulley system around which a chain or wire rope is wound, allowing for controlled lifting, and lowering operations.

subjects.description: Industrial machinery used for vertically transporting people, goods, or materials between levels within a building or structure; includes passenger lifts, goods lifts and platform lifts.
subjects.source_quote: Industrial machinery used for vertically transporting people, goods, or materials between various levels within a building or structure. Lifts, also known as elevators, come in various configurations, including passenger lifts, goods lifts, and platform lifts

subjects.description: Lifting equipment and gears used in factories, construction sites, hotels and other workplaces. Named in the requirement clause rather than the definitions section.
subjects.source_quote: Cranes, hoists, lifts, lifting equipment and gears, forklifts, etc. used in factories, construction sites, hotels, and other workplaces shall be tested and certified

subjects.description: Forklifts are named inside GU48's requirement 1 as well as being the subject of GU146. GU48 therefore imposes the 12-month third-party test on forklifts independently of GU146.
subjects.source_quote: Cranes, hoists, lifts, lifting equipment and gears, forklifts, etc. used in factories, construction sites, hotels, and other workplaces shall be tested and certified by a third party accredited by Emirates International Accreditation Center (EIAC) once every 12 months.

subjects.description: Named only in requirement 10 (operator certification), not in requirement 1. Recorded for completeness of asset scope.
subjects.source_quote: Operators of lifting equipment such as cranes, hoists, forklifts, cradles, etc.

examinations.applies_to: Cranes, hoists, lifts, lifting equipment and gears, forklifts, etc. used in factories, construction sites, hotels, and other workplaces
examinations.cadence_note: Interval is explicit. The document states no certificate validity period, so certificate_validity_months is null; do not infer 12 months from the test interval.
examinations.examiner_competence: A third party accredited by Emirates International Accreditation Center (EIAC). Only technically qualified and experienced persons by EIAC shall examine, test and certify. The company/competent person seeking accreditation must hold a Trade License issued by the Dubai Economic Department, hold professional liability insurance coverage, and meet any other requirements issued by the centre.
examinations.source_quote: 1- Cranes, hoists, lifts, lifting equipment and gears, forklifts, etc. used in factories, construction sites, hotels, and other workplaces shall be tested and certified by a third party accredited by Emirates International Accreditation Center (EIAC) once every 12 months.

examinations.applies_to: Any item of lifting equipment on which repairs have been carried out; the certificate of safety is issued only after examination and test and only after repairs are complete
examinations.trigger_event: after repairs have been carried out
examinations.source_quote: 4- A accredited third party shall issue a certificate of safety after due examination and test, and only after any repairs have been carried out, specifying the serial number, technical details, tests are done, safe working load … etc. for each equipment.

examinations.applies_to: Equipment judged unsafe by the accredited third party — use must cease and a report must be sent immediately to the Health and Safety Department
examinations.trigger_event: third party considers the equipment unsafe
examinations.source_quote: 6- If the accredited third party considers that the equipment is unsafe, the owner must be advised to cease use of the equipment and a report must be sent immediately to the Health and Safety Department.

examinations.applies_to: PERSON, not plant: operators of lifting equipment such as cranes, hoists, forklifts, cradles etc. used in factories, construction sites, residential and commercial buildings and other workplaces
examinations.cadence_note: The document sets no renewal interval for operator certification and states no validity period. Silent.
examinations.examiner_competence: A third party accredited by Emirates International Accreditation Center (EIAC). Training institutes training operators, riggers and signalpersons shall be registered and approved by the Knowledge and Human Development Authority (KHDA).
examinations.source_quote: 10- Operators of lifting equipment such as cranes, hoists, forklifts, cradles, etc. used in factories, construction sites, residential and commercial buildings and other workplaces shall be certified by a third party accredited by Emirates International Accreditation Center (EIAC).

examinations.applies_to: PERSON, not plant: workers involved in lifting operations — signalperson / signalman and rigger
examinations.cadence_note: No renewal interval or validity period stated. Silent.
examinations.examiner_competence: A third party accredited by Emirates International Accreditation Center (EIAC)
examinations.source_quote: 11- Workers involved in lifting operation such as signalperson / signalman and rigger shall be certified by a third party accredited by Emirates International Accreditation Center (EIAC).
